description: 2a_Excel input files - energy system modelling is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Katrin Lammers. Input files for three case study islands (Hons Son Cha, Magyi Kyun and Bulon Don) used to conduct the energy system modelling with Homer. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. Formats: Excel. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is This dataset is made available under the Open Data Commons Attribution License: http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/by/1.0/. A summary of the license. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
